newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL - Electrolux H1 loss put at 305 mln Sk.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Electrolux H1 loss put at 305 mln Sk.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker Electrolux is expected to post a loss after financial items of 305 million crowns for the first six months of the year, a Reuter survey of 12 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts ranged from a loss of 89 million crowns to a loss of 522 million, compared to a profit after financial items of 1.81 billion crowns in the corresponding year-earlier period.
The expected loss derives from restructuring costs of 2.5 billion crowns which are not fully counterbalanced by capital gains of 600 million crowns.
For the full year, Electrolux is seen posting a pre-tax profit of 1.32 billion crowns.
The six-month operating profit before extraordinary items is seen at 2.35 billion crowns and for the full-year at 4.46 billion crowns.
Electrolux is due to present its six-month results on August 6.
